# DSH Harness Ecosystem Catalog

> Multilingual catalog of DeepSeek Harness (DSH) artifacts: 10,368 community plugins plus desktop apps, hosted services, bots, marketplaces and documentation sites. Every entry carries upstream security signals (capability red lines) and OSV advisories.

## What this is
A free, searchable index of the DSH ecosystem. Use it to find plugins, vet their security risk, compare features, and copy install commands. Listing is not endorsement: plugins are community code; install at your own risk.

## Page types
- Plugin/artifact detail: https://harness-market-ds.refertur.net/p/<slug>/
- Category: https://harness-market-ds.refertur.net/category/<category>/
- Type: https://harness-market-ds.refertur.net/type/<kind>/
- Capability: https://harness-market-ds.refertur.net/capability/<capability>/
- Tag: https://harness-market-ds.refertur.net/tag/<tag>/
- Author: https://harness-market-ds.refertur.net/author/<owner>/
- Security report: https://harness-market-ds.refertur.net/security/
- Search: https://harness-market-ds.refertur.net/search/?q=<query>
- FAQ: https://harness-market-ds.refertur.net/faq/
- Docs: https://harness-market-ds.refertur.net/docs/

## Data freshness
- Registry (awesome-dsh-plugin): updated daily; stars/downloads refreshed daily by upstream CI.
- CDN format-1 index: fetched daily with count verification.
- Security: OSV advisories queried for ~5,126 npm packages.

## How to cite
“DSH Harness Ecosystem Catalog, https://harness-market-ds.refertur.net (retrieved <date>).”
